section_summary.extract_value: This section presents construct validity evidence for the Dutch BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2), demonstrating good convergent validity through significant correlations with appearance satisfaction, functionality satisfaction, self-esteem, and optimistic life orientation, and significant negative correlations with self-objectification and BMI. Incremental validity was assessed using hierarchical regression analyses with a sample of 306 participants, showing that BAS-2 scores made significant incremental contributions to predicting both self-esteem and optimistic life orientation beyond appearance and functionality satisfaction alone.
